published_inputs.name: Ordinary Cayley identity
published_inputs.title: Algebraic/combinatorial proofs of Cayley-type identities for derivatives of determinants and pfaffians
published_inputs.theorem: Theorem 2.1, ordinary one-matrix identity; arXiv version 2, page 7
published_inputs.exact_used_statement: det(partial_X) det(X)^m = product_{j=0}^{r-1}(m+j) det(X)^{m-1} for r,m>=1 over Q, hence any characteristic-zero field.
published_inputs.scope_note: No p-adic, geometric, metric, global family or RH premise; retained as a published classical input, not claimed newly proved.
